items.name: Real Estate Video & Photography
items.line: Real estate photography, listing videos, drone footage where permitted and agent introduction videos for residential properties and developments.
items.title: Real Estate Video & Photography in NJ & NYC | Turtle House
items.desc: Real estate photography, listing videos, drone footage and agent videos in Jersey City, Hoboken, Manhattan, Brooklyn and surrounding areas.
items.lead: Good property marketing helps buyers understand the layout, finishes and feel of a home before they schedule a showing. We create real estate videos and photography for agents, brokers, homeowners and developers across New Jersey and New York City.
body: Every property has details worth showing: the layout, natural light, finishes, views and connection to the surrounding neighborhood. We plan the filming sequence around the strongest features of the home and create a set of images and videos that work together.
We can capture photography and video during the same visit, helping keep the look consistent across the listing, website and social media.

deliv.title: Property listing videos
deliv.text: Professionally edited property films, with horizontal and vertical versions for listing websites and social media.

deliv.title: Real estate photography
deliv.text: Wide interior and exterior images, architectural details and, when appropriate, twilight photography.

deliv.title: Drone video & photography
deliv.text: Aerial views of properties and surrounding areas where local regulations, airspace and permissions allow.

deliv.title: Agent introduction videos
deliv.text: Short on-camera videos that introduce the agent and help potential clients get to know the person behind the listing.

deliv.title: Social media content
deliv.text: Reels, Stories and other short-form edits created from the property shoot.

faq.q: Can you shoot both video and photography in one visit?
faq.a: Yes. We can plan both as part of the same production visit. The schedule depends on the size of the property and the number of deliverables.

faq.q: Do you create vertical videos for Instagram and TikTok?
faq.a: Yes. We can frame and edit vertical versions specifically for mobile viewing, alongside horizontal versions for websites and other platforms.
Yes, where the location, airspace rules and required permissions allow it. We confirm feasibility before the shoot.
We are based in Weehawken, New Jersey, and work across Hudson County, North Jersey, Manhattan, Brooklyn and Queens. We also travel for selected projects in Washington, DC and Northern Virginia.

steps.text: We review the property, access details, priorities and intended platforms. Then we prepare a shot list and schedule.

steps.title: Film & photograph
steps.text: We capture the property with attention to its layout, natural light and defining details. Drone work is subject to airspace rules and permissions.

steps.text: We edit and color-grade the video, process the photographs and export the agreed formats for listing platforms and social media.

items.title: Luxury Brand Video Production in NYC & NJ | Turtle House
items.desc: Video production and photography for luxury brands, fine jewelry, watches, private aviation, yachts and high-end properties in New York and New Jersey.
items.lead: Premium products and spaces deserve thoughtful production. Turtle House creates video and photography for fine jewelry, watches, private aviation, yachts and high-end properties, with careful lighting, considered compositions and attention to detail.
body: Reflective materials, compact interiors and carefully designed spaces require more than simply pointing a camera and recording. We plan lighting, camera movement and compositions around the subject and the location.

We keep production focused and work with the client’s schedule and access requirements. If a project is private or not intended for our portfolio, we respect that. We will only share client work publicly with written approval.

faq.q: Can you film in our boutique outside business hours?
faq.a: Yes. When needed, we can arrange filming before or after opening hours, subject to the location’s schedule and access approval.

faq.q: Can you film at Teterboro and other private aviation facilities?
faq.a: Aviation filming must be coordinated with the aircraft operator and the relevant airport or FBO. We can discuss the project and confirm access requirements before scheduling.

faq.q: Will you share our project on your social media?
faq.a: Only with your written approval. If the project is confidential or should remain private, we will respect that.

faq.q: Do you work with jewelry and watches?
faq.a: Yes. We can create product films and photography that focus on the materials, design and details of jewelry and watches.

items.lead: A hotel is more than a room. Guests want to see the atmosphere, the amenities and the details that make a stay worth booking. We create hotel and resort videos and photography that give potential guests a clear sense of the experience before they arrive.

We also coordinate with your team on room access, housekeeping and guest activity to keep disruption to a minimum.

items.name: Restaurant Video & Food Photography
items.line: Food photography, menu videos, restaurant Reels and interior photography for restaurants, bars and hospitality groups.
items.title: Restaurant Video & Food Photography in NYC & NJ | Turtle House
items.desc: Restaurant video production, food photography, menu photography and social media Reels for restaurants in New York City and New Jersey.
items.lead: People often discover a restaurant online before they visit. We create food photography, menu images and short-form videos that show the dishes, the space and the atmosphere—giving customers a better idea of what to expect.
body: Food needs to look appealing while still looking like the dish a guest will receive. We pay attention to lighting, presentation and timing, and coordinate with the restaurant team so dishes can be photographed soon after they leave the kitchen.
We can also capture the interior, staff, preparation and atmosphere during the same shoot, creating a varied collection of content for your website and social channels.

deliv.title: Menu photography
deliv.text: Carefully lit images of dishes and drinks for menus, websites and delivery or booking platforms.

deliv.title: Restaurant Reels
deliv.text: Short vertical videos featuring food preparation, signature dishes, drinks and the restaurant atmosphere.

deliv.title: Interior photography
deliv.text: Images of dining rooms, bars, outdoor seating and the details that give a restaurant its character.

deliv.title: Menu launches & openings
deliv.text: Photo and video content for new menus, seasonal updates, new locations and opening events.

deliv.title: Food & drink videos
deliv.text: Close-up video of plating, preparation, pours and other details that bring the menu to life.

faq.q: How long does a restaurant shoot take?
faq.a: It depends on the number of dishes, the size of the location and the content required. We plan the schedule with your team in advance and work around service where possible.

faq.q: Can you photograph our full menu?
faq.a: Yes. We can plan a menu photography session around the number of dishes and the way the images will be used.

faq.q: Do you create Reels for Instagram?
faq.a: Yes. We produce short vertical videos for Instagram Reels and can prepare versions for other social platforms.

faq.q: Can we use the photos on Google and reservation platforms?
faq.a: We can provide appropriately sized image files for your website, Google Business Profile and supported booking or reservation platforms. Please let us know which platforms you use.

items.name: Client Testimonial Video Production
items.line: Interview-led videos featuring real customers, homeowners and clients for remodelers, builders, designers and service businesses.
items.title: Client Testimonial Video Production in NJ & NYC | Turtle House
items.desc: Customer testimonial and client story videos for remodelers, builders, designers and service businesses in New Jersey and New York.
items.lead: A real customer can explain the value of your work in a way a sales pitch cannot. We produce interview-led testimonial videos that let clients share their experience in their own words, supported by footage of the finished project and the people behind it.
body: Not everyone feels comfortable speaking on camera. We keep the setup relaxed, ask clear questions and give people time to explain their experience naturally. We do not need clients to memorize a script or deliver rehearsed lines.
The interview is supported by footage of the finished space, the work itself and the details that help viewers understand the project.

deliv.title: Client interviews
deliv.text: Professionally filmed interviews with clean audio, thoughtful lighting and a comfortable setup.

deliv.title: Project footage
deliv.text: Supporting video of the finished work, materials, details and before-and-after results where available.

deliv.title: Full testimonial films
deliv.text: Longer edits for your website, proposals and sales presentations.

deliv.title: Short-form edits
deliv.text: Shorter versions for social media and digital advertising.

deliv.title: Captions
deliv.text: On-screen captions to make videos easier to follow when viewers watch without sound.

faq.q: Do you write a script for the client?
faq.a: We generally use interview questions and talking points rather than a word-for-word script. This helps clients speak naturally and in their own words.

faq.q: Can you make short ads from a testimonial?
faq.a: Yes. We can create shorter edits for social media and digital advertising from the interview footage.

faq.q: Do you film at the customer’s home or project location?
faq.a: Yes, when the location and participants are available. A finished home, renovation or completed project can provide useful visual context for the story.

items.index_line: Customer interviews and testimonial films for remodelers, builders, designers and service businesses.
items.why_h2: A comfortable interview makes a better story.

steps.text: We discuss the story, interview participants, location and intended use. We prepare interview topics and a production plan.

steps.title: Edit & deliver
steps.text: We create the main testimonial film and the agreed shorter edits, with captions and formats for your website and social channels.
